title: David's Kindness to Mephibosheth
reflectionQuestion: David gave Mephibosheth a place at his table, so he would always feel welcome. Who is someone you could help feel that they belong?
kidSafetyNotes: NEW anchor (David, secondary/short-only). The KINDNESS gem -- pays off 1846 David & Jonathan (David keeps his promise to Jonathan by welcoming Jonathan's SON) WITHOUT repeating it: distinct scene (the king's table), distinct beat (welcome/belonging). Mephibosheth's disability ('his feet were hurt when he was little, so he cannot walk') is stated matter-of-factly, with DIGNITY -- the story is about welcome + a place at the table, NEVER pity; flag disability_portrayed_with_dignity. For a left-out / forgotten / 'do I belong' child: Mephibosheth thought he was forgotten -> welcomed like family. Indelible image = a place set just for him at the king's table, every day, for life. 'God' not central here (kindness story); no Yahweh. VOICE_JAMES_BRITISH (reassuring father) -- warm, steady welcome. NOTE: reuses David character but NOT VOICE_DAVID_SHEPHERD (rested; and the narrator isn't David).
